title: Generative AI Questions
definition: Questions exploring the broader ecosystem of GenAI, including image generation (Diffusion), multi-modality, and copyright/ethics.
simpleExplanation: Testing your knowledge of the field beyond just text-based chatbots.
realWorldExample: Being asked: 'How do Diffusion models differ from older GAN (Generative Adversarial Network) architectures?'

basic: What does it mean if a model is 'Multimodal'?
intermediate: Explain the basic concept of a Diffusion Model.

answers.question: What is Multimodal?
answers.answer: The model can natively process and understand multiple types of data inputs simultaneously, such as text, audio waves, and images, within the same neural network.

answers.question: Diffusion Model?
answers.answer: An image generation architecture that is trained by slowly adding static (noise) to a picture until it is destroyed. The model learns how to reverse the process. In production, you give it pure static, and it 'denoises' it into a perfect image based on a text prompt.
